sources.name: OGD / DMI AGMARKNET mandi prices
sources.access: API key + verified historical exports
sources.real_data: Published market min/modal/max prices, variety, grade, arrivals when provided
sources.refresh: Daily; retain every source snapshot
sources.limits: Current daily resource does not guarantee a 365-day historical API. Preserve missing trading days. Validate original units; INR/quintal, INR/tonne and INR/100 nuts are different. Track source license and attribution.
sources.mock_policy: 365-day synthetic history permitted in demo DB. Future year only labeled scenarios; never actual mandi prices.

sources.name: eNAM trade dashboards
sources.access: Permitted export or approved access; no documented stable public API verified
sources.real_data: APMC trade prices, arrivals and quantities where published
sources.refresh: Daily if approved; otherwise documented manual snapshots
sources.limits: Do not build dependencies on undocumented private endpoints or bypass access controls. Compare the same crop, grade, variety and unit.
sources.mock_policy: Fictional demo trades; not completed real transactions.

sources.name: Official MSP notifications
sources.access: Reviewed public notifications
sources.real_data: Crop/grade MSP for announced marketing seasons
sources.refresh: On new notification; periodic review
sources.limits: MSP is a policy reference, not every farmer’s guaranteed sale price. Future effective rates can be real when officially announced. Keep announcement/effective dates.
sources.mock_policy: Demo values must be synthetic policy fixtures, never presented as official MSP. Current seed leaves this empty.

sources.name: Open-Meteo weather and reanalysis
sources.access: Anonymous hosted API for qualifying free use; commercial plan or self-hosting as applicable
sources.real_data: Daily/hourly model weather, historical reanalysis, short-range forecasts and ET0
sources.format: JSON time arrays with explicit units
sources.refresh: Forecast every 6 hours per distinct grid; historical updates daily
sources.limits: Forecast API up to 16 days. Reanalysis is modeled history, not a farm sensor. Free hosted service is for noncommercial use under its limits; data license and hosted-service terms differ.
sources.mock_policy: One future year may be seasonal/climate scenarios, not precise daily forecasts. Cache by grid, model and issuance.

sources.name: NASA POWER
sources.access: Public documented API
sources.real_data: Historical agroclimate, solar radiation, temperature, humidity, rainfall
sources.refresh: Daily cached shared grid; bounded historical jobs
sources.limits: Coarse grid context, not local soil sensor. Keep UTC versus local solar time explicit. Batch parameters and reuse grid data.
sources.mock_policy: Synthetic radiation/ET0 allowed demo only; derived irrigation advice states assumptions.

sources.name: IMD weather, warnings and agromet
sources.access: Registered/approved API access where required
sources.real_data: City forecasts, station weather, district warnings, nowcasts and advisories
sources.refresh: Endpoint-dependent; warnings prioritized
sources.limits: Sample probe returned 401. Do not promise anonymous access. Respect endpoint issuance, validity and authentication conditions.
sources.mock_policy: Mock warnings exercise UI in demo; never issue simulated official alerts to real farmers.

sources.name: ISRIC SoilGrids
sources.access: Downloaded maps/cache; REST optional
sources.real_data: Modeled soil pH, organic carbon, texture and related properties at multiple depths
sources.refresh: Versioned map releases; cache per grid/depth
sources.limits: 250 m predictions include uncertainty; not plot lab NPK. Official docs warn REST temporarily paused although this sample returned 200. License depends on release; retain version.
sources.mock_policy: Synthetic lab-looking numbers remain synthetic. Do not fabricate Soil Health Card or precision fertilizer requirements.

sources.name: Farmer-uploaded soil lab / Soil Health Card
sources.access: Consent-based upload; no verified public personal-record bulk API
sources.real_data: Consented reports covering N/P/K, S, Zn/Fe/Cu/Mn/B, pH/EC/organic carbon; extraction method, original units and nutrient basis
sources.refresh: When farmer submits new report
sources.limits: OCR can misread decimals/units. Preserve original evidence; never automatically call a grid prediction a laboratory result.
sources.mock_policy: Demo synthetic samples have no lab name, report URI or verified result.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 / STAC
sources.access: Public catalog; asset/processing access and quotas may require account
sources.real_data: Scene metadata, surface-reflectance imagery, cloud masks; derived field indices
sources.refresh: Discover new scenes; process only selected fields
sources.limits: Catalog success does not prove processing entitlement. Cloud gaps stay missing. NDVI is not disease ground truth or guaranteed yield. Keep pixel coverage and cloud masking.
sources.mock_policy: Mock index curves only with synthetic method; no invented real scene IDs. Seed does not fabricate satellite assets.

sources.name: Local Government Directory
sources.access: Official versioned directory downloads
sources.real_data: State/UT/district/block/village identity and hierarchy
sources.refresh: Monthly and on reorganization
sources.limits: Use actual downloaded LGD codes and validity ranges. Demo IDs use a distinct DEMO code system.
sources.mock_policy: Approximate public anchors and fictional plots are allowed; not real cadastre or official village identifiers.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap maps and place context
sources.access: Licensed extracts/self-hosting for bulk; public service policies apply
sources.real_data: Public roads, places and map features
sources.refresh: Versioned extracts; avoid repeated geocoding
sources.limits: Nominatim public API max 1 request/sec, attribution, identifying client and caching; no bulk systematic harvesting or private farmer data submission. Public tiles are best effort, not production/offline infrastructure.
sources.mock_policy: Fictional locations separate from actual geocoded real farms.

sources.name: ICAR / KVK agricultural guidance
sources.access: Reviewed public documents with rights/attribution retained
sources.real_data: Crop, region, season and growth-stage advisories
sources.refresh: On publication; seasonal review
sources.limits: Review regional fit, language and chemical advice. Store publication/review dates. Do not invent universal sowing dates or harvest yields.
sources.mock_policy: Demo calendar templates allowed but must be localized and labeled examples.

sources.name: myScheme + originating departments
sources.access: Curated imports / approved integration; no public API verified
sources.real_data: Benefits, eligibility questions, application steps and official links
sources.refresh: Monthly and whenever rules change
sources.limits: Recommend potential matches with missing questions; only an official decision proves acceptance. Keep state, season and effective dates.
sources.mock_policy: Mock application workflow only; never mock successful government approval or disbursement.

sources.name: PMFBY notifications / insurance guidance
sources.access: Public current guidelines; personal claim access requires permission
sources.real_data: Scheme guidance, notified crop/area/season requirements
sources.refresh: Seasonal notification updates
sources.limits: Personal claim/payment status is not public data. Crop loss cases need actual evidence and official processes.
sources.mock_policy: Fictional claims stay demonstration examples; no real claim submission or payouts.

sources.name: DES / OGD crop area-production-yield
sources.access: Published aggregate downloads
sources.real_data: District/state crop area, production, yield by year/season
sources.refresh: On annual/seasonal release
sources.limits: Keep estimate versus final status. District averages are not an individual field’s measured yield.
sources.mock_policy: Mock aggregate baselines for demos; not survey evidence or forecast model evaluation.

sources.name: PPQS / CIBRC current labels and notices
sources.access: Reviewed current official releases
sources.real_data: Registered crop/pest uses and restrictions
sources.refresh: On every relevant revision; review before recommendation
sources.limits: An old 2024 document is not proof of current permitted use. Obtain latest labels/notices. Human review before pesticide dosage guidance.
sources.mock_policy: Never fabricate legal registrations, doses or bans; leave uncertain recommendations unresolved.

sources.name: PlantVillage / PlantDoc evaluation images
sources.access: Dataset repository; verify release rights and image provenance
sources.real_data: Labeled benchmark crop images for evaluation research
sources.refresh: Versioned dataset releases
sources.limits: Controlled images are not real field performance. Group by leaf/source/farm to avoid train/test leakage. Verify license, avoid invented labels and diagnose with uncertainty.
sources.mock_policy: Synthetic pictures cannot replace disease ground truth or validate diagnosis accuracy.

sources.name: FAO irrigation / ET0 methodology
sources.access: Public method references
sources.real_data: Derived ET0 and crop-water planning methodology
sources.refresh: Recompute on validated weather/crop inputs
sources.limits: Output depends on units, crop coefficients and site assumptions. A recommendation does not prove a pump ran.
sources.mock_policy: Mock recommendations in demo; never execute hardware without real integration and acknowledgment.

sources.name: Farmer onboarding / authorized AgriStack
sources.access: Direct consent; AgriStack only with authorized access
sources.real_data: Farmer’s own profile, fields, contacts, crop plans and records
sources.refresh: At onboarding and confirmed changes
sources.limits: No public 400-person profile feed assumed. Do not harvest contact details or government identities. Deletion, revocation and access control required.
sources.mock_policy: Generate 400 fictional profiles spanning India; use reserved example.invalid emails and null phones.

sources.name: Real hardware protocol / mock adapter
sources.access: Authenticated device registration; same validated envelope for mock
sources.real_data: Timestamped calibrated telemetry and actual action acknowledgments
sources.format: MQTT or HTTPS JSON, device/boot/sequence IDs
sources.refresh: Based on actual firmware interval; mock fixture hourly
sources.limits: Separate observed time/received time, units, quality, drift and connectivity. Authenticate device; derive farmer ownership server-side; duplicate boot+sequence rejected. Current CSV seed is not a running MQTT connector.
sources.mock_policy: Mock readings, outages, low battery, drought and rain safely in demo; no real actuator commands or delivery.

sources.name: BHASHINI language / voice services
sources.access: Organization registration, authorization and pipeline access
sources.real_data: ASR, translation and TTS through authorized pipelines
sources.refresh: Resolve approved language/model pipeline; cache nonprivate terminology
sources.limits: Published API docs describe PoC use; production/charging users requires contacting BHASHINI for paid access. Do not promise free commercial voice. Preserve original utterance and ask confirmation for uncertain crop names/numbers.
sources.mock_policy: Mock transcript/translation fixtures explicitly; no claim of speech accuracy from mocked text.
sources.implementation_status: researched in final review; connector not implemented

sources.name: ICAR KVK / expert referral directory
sources.access: Reviewed official directory, dated per record
sources.real_data: Regional agricultural extension institutions and official contact/location details
sources.refresh: Quarterly review and before showing contact
sources.limits: Referral does not prove an appointment or consultation. Verify contacts; do not harvest private expert numbers. Current platform has no expert-booking integration.
sources.mock_policy: Use Demo expert referral only; never invent actual expert availability or contact.
sources.implementation_status: researched in final review; connector not implemented

sources.name: National Pest Surveillance System
sources.access: Official farmer portal/app or approved integration; public API not verified
sources.real_data: Official pest/disease identification and surveillance guidance
sources.refresh: On approved published update or farmer referral
sources.limits: Useful crop-doctor referral, not an assumed free diagnosis API or downloadable ground-truth photo database. Keep uploaded photos consented and escalation explicit.
sources.mock_policy: Mock symptom/question flow without inventing a diagnosis, expert review or chemical treatment approval.
sources.implementation_status: researched in final review; connector not implemented

sources.name: NDMA SACHET / official disaster alerts
sources.access: Official portal RSS subscription; verify current endpoint, terms and attribution
sources.real_data: Geo-targeted authorized warnings, severity, affected area, expiry and actions; sources include IMD/CWC
sources.refresh: Poll within published feed policy; preserve expiry/update/cancel references
sources.limits: Official portal advertises RSS; feed parser/endpoints were not integration-tested. No private API scraping. Match affected area and validity, handle duplicate updates/cancellations. Missing alerts do not prove safety.
sources.mock_policy: Demo alerts stay labeled and cannot trigger real external delivery. Do not fabricate official disaster warnings.
sources.implementation_status: researched in final review; connector not implemented

sources.name: NABARD model project economics
sources.access: Reviewed public model project documents
sources.real_data: Indicative cost categories/project budgeting structures
sources.refresh: Version/date review; update actual input costs from farmer/local quotes
sources.limits: Model bankable projects are templates, not current input prices, farmer income guarantees or loan approvals. Show assumptions, location, publication year and sensitivity. No automated financial commitment.
sources.mock_policy: Mock quantities and costs for demo budgets; clearly distinguish estimates from recorded expenses and proceeds.
sources.implementation_status: researched in final review; connector not implemented

sources.name: AI4Bharat self-hosted language models
sources.access: Download/self-host release with verified model and dataset licenses
sources.real_data: Language model and evaluation resources, not real farm records
sources.refresh: Pin release and evaluate before update
sources.limits: IndicTrans2 supports scheduled Indian languages. Code licensing is not a blanket license for every weight/dataset. Hosting and inference require compute; rural dialect, crop-name and numeric accuracy need evaluation.
sources.mock_policy: Mock language fixtures exercise rendering, not speech or translation accuracy.
sources.implementation_status: researched; optional self-hosted path, not installed
